title: gParaKV: A GPGPU-accelerated Key-Value Separation-based KV Store with Optimized Compaction and Garbage Collection
problem: LSM-tree KV stores suffer from compaction and garbage collection bottlenecks; key-value separation methods don't fully address merge-sorting and expensive GC overhead
motivation: LSM-trees widely used in cloud storage; compaction severely impacts performance at scale; GPU parallelism could accelerate these bottleneck operations
method: gParaKV: GPGPU-empowered KV store with key-value separation; parallel merge-sorting and GC; GPGPU bitmap structure; parallel data marking mechanism
key_novelty: GPU acceleration of compaction merge-sorting and garbage collection; bitmap and parallel marking structures for efficient GPU utilization
contributions: Improved write performance vs separation-based KV stores
limitations: Detailed performance numbers not in abstract; applicability to read-heavy workloads unclear
